page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7nex.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance from the Enhanced family, designed for processor-intensive operations requiring substantial parallel thread processing. Powered by the x86_64 architecture, the instance incorporates 64 dedicated virtual cores based on the Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock frequency of 2.7 GHz. System memory is configured with 128.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio corresponding to 2.0 GB per virtual core.

Network connectivity is a primary architectural feature of this instance, delivering an 80 Gbps baseline network bandwidth via KVM virtualization. The system includes zero local storage, requiring workloads to rely entirely on attached network-based block storage volumes or remote object stores for data persistence. Hardware acceleration via dedicated GPUs is not included in this configuration.

From an operational perspective, the 1:2 memory-to-vCPU allocation limits unnecessary memory overhead costs for compute-heavy tasks where higher RAM densities would remain unutilized. However, the lack of onboard NVMe storage introduces reliance on network storage latency and throughput for intensive input-output operations. The instance is suited for batch processing, distributed software compilation, compute-bound microservices architectures, and high-throughput network proxying.

It provides 64 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.7 GHz, paired with 128.0 GB of system memory to maintain a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per core. Engineered for high-throughput distributed communication, the instance features an 80 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. There is no bundled local disk storage or GPU accelerator on this instance, necessitating remote cloud storage for persistent file systems. This resource profile offers cost efficiency for compute-dense operations by avoiding redundant memory overhead, though workloads requiring ultra-low-latency scratch disks must account for network storage constraints. The ecs.c7nex.16xlarge is suitable for distributed batch processing, high-traffic web tiers, code compilation clusters, and continuous integration pipelines.
